description: Variable name capitalization mismatch: line 79 defines `Now = datetime.datetime.now(...)` while line 97 accesses `now.isoformat()`. When `write_receipts` is invoked at runtime, this will raise `NameError: name 'now' is not defined` when constructing receipt file payloads.

Timestamp monotonicity check depends on receipt files being read in chronological (cycle, pass) order. Because filenames use unpadded cycle indices (`receipt-c{cycle}p{pass}.json`), standard alphabetical file sorting (e.g., via glob) orders `receipt-c10...` before `receipt-c2...`. When cycle count reaches 10 or higher, cycle 10's timestamp will precede cycle 2's timestamp in the evaluated list, causing `ts != sorted(ts)` to fail at runtime with 'timestamps not monotonic'.
